title: Tic-Tac-Toe - Two-Agent Showdown
objective: Play a complete game of tic-tac-toe against your opponent. Try to win by making three of your marks in a row, column or diagonal, and block your opponent's threats. Nova is X and moves first; Atlas is O. Alternate turns placing marks in empty cells numbered 1-9, left to right, top to bottom. A full board without a winner is a draw. Completing the game is the verified episode goal, not both players winning.
opening_narrative:
Nova and Atlas sit across a three-by-three tic-tac-toe board. Nova holds X and Atlas holds O.

They take turns placing one mark in an empty square. Three matching marks across a row, down a column or along a diagonal wins; a full board with no winner is a draw.

agents.role: Nova: you are X and move first. Compete against Atlas using play_tic_tac_toe. Study the public board, try to win, and block immediate threats. Choose only an empty cell on your turn.
Atlas: you are O and move second. Compete against Nova using play_tic_tac_toe. Study the public board, try to win, and block immediate threats. Choose only an empty cell on your turn.

body.description: A seated player able to place marks on a tic-tac-toe board.

arena.name: Tic-tac-toe table
arena.description: A shared three-by-three board. Cells are numbered 1, 2, 3 across the top row, 4, 5, 6 across the middle, and 7, 8, 9 across the bottom. The public board and whose turn it is appear in each observation.
